status: architecture inspected; authenticated proof of concept blocked by missing API-Football credentials

synchronization.schedules: hourly at minute 5 UTC; startup catch-up
synchronization.concurrency: PostgreSQL advisory locks; stored observations prevent older fixture overwrites

ids.clubMatch: Frontend/internal string match ID equals tournament_fixtures.id, currently the integer football-data.org ID. This is not provider-independent.
ids.worldCupMatch: matches.id is a string with legacy IDs and separate matchNumber aliases. Must resolve stored identity rather than assume all numeric URLs are provider IDs.
ids.teamsAndPlayers: Deterministic UUIDs from entity kind + provider + external ID via entityId(). Catalog payload.providerIds preserves known provider identifiers.
ids.apiFootballMapping: No existing API-Football fixture mapping found in inspected tables/code. Do not reuse football-data.org IDs.

storage.tournament_fixtures: Integer id, competitionId, season, kickoff, status, score JSONB, raw provider payload JSONB, observedAt.
storage.matches: Legacy/World Cup match table including score, venue, referees, goals JSONB and provider team IDs.
storage.football_catalog: Teams, players and stadiums; providerKey plus payload/providerIds JSONB.
storage.tournament_resource_cache: key, payload JSONB, fetchedAt, expiresAt. Existing cache can be reused with an isolated API-Football namespace.
storage.schemaCaution: AppModule currently uses TypeORM synchronize=true. Do not register new entities before deliberately reviewing/applying the mapping migration.

details.failureHandling: Stored cache returned with freshness.stale=true when upstream refresh fails. Transaction locks prevent duplicate cache refreshes.
details.currentParsing: FootballService.details currently parses football-data.org goals/bookings/substitutions, home/away lineup/bench and statistics inline. Supplemental provider-specific parsing must live outside this service.

frontend.contract: packages/football-contracts/index.d.ts: MatchDetails, MatchEvent, MatchStat, Lineup, Availability
frontend.serverFetch: apps/web/src/lib/api/football.ts: server-only request to Nest; Next server component MatchDetailsPage passes details into MatchCentre.
frontend.browserNetwork: Initial match-details fetch runs on the Next server, so the upstream Nest request is not a browser fetch. Provider requests must remain backend-only.
frontend.compatibility: Keep events/lineups/stats fields and their existing types. Add structured optional normalized detail/resource metadata; retain names-only starters/substitutes. Existing MatchStat requires two numbers, so expose only valid pairs there and preserve one-sided/null provider values in additive structured rows.

proofOfConceptPlan.requiredCredential: API_FOOTBALL_API_KEY in apps/api/.env; direct API-Sports versus RapidAPI authentication host must match the account
sequence: Inspect authenticated subscription/status and remaining daily/minute request budget without saving account details or credentials.
Discover provider league IDs and season-specific coverage from /leagues; do not assume fixture IDs or feature support.

Query narrowly scoped /fixtures by discovered league ID, season and kickoff date/range. Compare both teams, home/away order and kickoff time; require one confident candidate, record ambiguous matches for manual review.

For each confidently identified provider fixture, inspect /fixtures?id, /fixtures/events?fixture, /fixtures/statistics?fixture, /fixtures/lineups?fixture and /fixtures/players?fixture only for features covered by the competition/season.
Validate HTTP status, errors envelope, result counts, nullable values, lineup player IDs/numbers/positions/grid and substitute coverage. Save sanitized raw responses and selected quota headers.
Check historical season access separately; historical success alone does not prove current 2026 fixture access.
Count every attempted provider request and retain returned quota headers. No unbounded retries or paid purchases.
Implement only after required actual data for both supported competition samples is confirmed.
proofOfConceptPlan.documentedSubscriptionRestriction: Official October 26, 2026 article states Free Plan season access is Year-4 through Year-2 (2022-2024 in 2026). This account's actual plan and access remain unverified.

proposedImplementationAfterProof.providerBoundary: Separate ApiFootball module/client/normalizer/aggregation service. FootballService consumes normalized supplemental data only.
proposedImplementationAfterProof.mapping: Persistent mapping with unique internalMatchId+provider and provider+externalFixtureId; retain competition, season, both provider team IDs, kickoff, verification evidence and timestamps. Flag ambiguous candidates, never auto-bind them.

normalization.rawData: Cache original sanitized provider payload separately from normalization for reprocessing; never return authentication headers or keys.

proposedImplementationAfterProof.aggregation: Keep primary fixtures/results/standings unchanged. Cache each supplemental resource under a provider namespace, use lifecycle-aware TTLs and cross-process deduplication, separate quota accounting, backoff and stale fallbacks. Track source/fetchedAt/availability by resource. Do not merge duplicate timelines from two providers or convert absent/null statistics to zero.
